note: The control for this whole group, and the reason its divergences are attributable: every character-indexed name kg wraps already answers exactly what Emacs answers on multibyte text -- both sides give (5 3 "hé" "本語" 233 "\"héllo\""). `length`, `elt` and `substring` are wrapped in lisp/prelude.el precisely because a fe string indexes by BYTE; this case is the evidence that the wrapping works, so string25-multibyte-aref-bytes next door is about the ONE name that was not wrapped rather than about UTF-8 in general.
